title: STRING ... ON OVERFLOW — concatenates with size check; OVERFLOW fires when target too short
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BUILD-KEY.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-PFX     PIC X(4)   VALUE "USR-".
       01  WS-NUM     PIC X(8).
       01  WS-KEY     PIC X(10).
      *> STRING concatenates WS-PFX + WS-NUM into WS-KEY.
      *> WS-KEY is 10 chars and the concatenation is 12; the
      *> trailing 2 are dropped. ON OVERFLOW fires before the drop
      *> is committed -- the legacy may use this to log a warning.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       BUILD.
           STRING WS-PFX DELIMITED BY SIZE,
                  WS-NUM DELIMITED BY SIZE
              INTO WS-KEY
              ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY "key truncated".
           STOP RUN.
notes: STRING with DELIMITED BY SIZE is the COBOL counterpart of unchecked concatenation. The OVERFLOW handler is the signal that legacy code knows about the truncation. A Java rewrite that uses '+' loses the overflow signal.
